name: dev
description: Enforced dev workflow (/dev + /spec + /prd) with dual-model review, independent evaluator architecture, AC-driven MODULE progress, aligned §N.M section numbering, ADR (Architecture Decision Records) system, upstream-alignment escape hatches, worktree-parallel /dev, read-only `/dev board` snapshot dashboard, a system-acceptance witness layer, and template-version drift visibility. Includes `dev`, `spec`, `prd` skills plus opt-in statusline. Latest: 2.12.0 every skill prints the running dev-template version and warns on session↔installed drift (a newer plugin installed mid-session); /spec + /prd stamp generated docs with `dev-template: vX.Y.Z` and flag artifact drift on rerun. Earlier: 2.9.0 read-only `/dev board` snapshot dashboard, 2.10.0 system-acceptance layer (system E2E readiness axis via REQ `Witness:e2e` + `docs/SYSTEM-ACCEPTANCE.md` + /dev DoD hard gate), 2.11.0 `/spec upgrade-template` adopts the system-acceptance layer into existing projects without a full rerun.
